LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.0.label: Soul Vessel
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.0.descri: Retains original soul growth, damage, regeneration and awakening. Later nodes require an actual integer soul gain from settled combat contribution. Fractional progress, capped gains and recursive settlement from star-generated damage do not trigger them. They spend no permanent souls; progression stays with the item.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.1.label: Lingering Echo
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.1.descri: After actually gaining souls, store one echo for 5 seconds. A later ordinary hit on an enemy spends it for 75 additional damage. One echo maximum, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Gaining several souls at once does not create extra echoes. Base rewards: damage 75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.2.label: Soulbound Veil
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.2.descri: After actually gaining souls, shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Several souls gained at once still grant only one shield. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.3.label: Divided Echo
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.3.descri: After Lingering Echo deals actual bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never strikes the original target again if no other enemy is available. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.4.label: Echo Recovery
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.4.descri: After Lingering Echo deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Prevented bonus damage grants no healing; permanent scars and missing parts are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.5.label: Shared Soul Lantern
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.5.descri: After actually gaining souls, also shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Resolves independently from Soulbound Veil; never substitutes you when no ally is eligible. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.6.label: Returning Breath
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Soulreaver.nodes.6.descri: After actually gaining souls, also heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Resolves independently from Soulbound Veil; full health grants nothing extra. Base rewards: healing 20.
